description: A document's rebuild errors and warnings.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

errors.description: How many features have a rebuild error.

warnings.description: How many features have a rebuild warning.

items.description: A feature with a rebuild error or warning.

code.description: SOLIDWORKS' error code name (swFeatureError_e), for example swFeatureErrorFilletNoEdge.

warning.description: True for a warning, false for an error.

items.description: Each feature with an error or warning.
